properties.title: Global Multihazard Mortality Risks and Distribution
properties.description: The Global Multihazard Mortality Risks and Distribution is a 2.5 minute grid identifying and characterizing the nature of multihazard risk at the global scale. For this study, multihazard considers the hazards posed by cyclones, droughts, earthquakes, floods, landslides and volcanoes. The specific hazards are grouped into the following hazard categories: drought (drought), seismic (earthquakes and volcanoes), and hydro (cyclones, floods, and landslides). Each grid cell is assessed for each hazard category; and is considered at high risk or not at high risk. Treated as a binary value, the at-risk values of the hazards categories function as a 3-digit index of multihazard. For each of the hazard category combinations, aggregate analyses determine the total population, area, and length of major transportation features, as well as, the value of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and agricultural GDP. This data set is the result of collaboration among the Columbia University Center for Hazards and Risk Research (CHRR), International Bank for Reconstruction and Development/The World Bank, and Columbia University Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN).

ciesin:field_schema.attrdef: Sum the agricultural value (US$, 2000, purchase power parity adjusted) within grid cells of a specific hazard category combination. Agvalue is based upon the allocation of available national estimates of agricultural GDP to grid cells dependent upon the amount of agricultural land within grid cells. Agricultural lands are identified using a reinterpretation of USGS Global Land Cover Characterization data. Agvalue is representative of the category combination.

Total land area within grid cellss of a specific hazard category combination after subtracting permenantly inundated areas. Permenantly inundated areas were identified using VMAP(0) data. Applicable to the category combination class as a whole.
Number of grid cells have the same Value attribution.
Binary variable (1 is true) signifying whether the grid cell is in the three highest deciles (8-10) of drought-based mortality risks.
Sum of purchase power parity adjusted (PPP) GDP (US$, 2000) within the specific hazards category combination. This estimate represents production not affected by any type of hazard.
Binary variable (1 is true) signifying whether the grid cell is in any of the highest deciles (8-10) of cyclone, flood, or landslide-based mortality risks.

Sum of year 2000 population per hazard category combination (the 3-digit sequence of Drought3, Seismic3, and Hydro3) as determined using Gridded Population of the World, Version 3 (GPWv3) data. It is not the population of an individual grid cell and is intended to serve as a comparative measure between category combination classes.
Binary variable (1 is true) signifying whether the grid cell is in the three highest deciles (8-10) of either volcano and/or earthquake based mortality risks.
Total length of major roads and railroads within grid cells of a specific hazard category combination. Roads and railroads were identified using VMAP(0) data.
A numeric identifier of the unique 3-digit sequence of the three hazard attributes (items Drought3, Seismic3, and Hydro3).
